evidence: Built rejection_fixture.py, a single-command CI-callable harness that runs the live workstreams/po03/tools/check_path_scope.py as a separate process across 16 scenarios and compares real exit status and output marker against a stated expectation. Executed it: PO03_FIXTURE_PASS scenarios=16 rejecting=14 passing=2 guard=check_path_scope.py, exit 0; with --include-repo-scope 5ef49cb148f5186397acf1303f325f726bb58543 it reports 17 scenarios all OK, exit 0, captured in evidence/fixture-run.txt. The deliberate mutation scenario commits state/PO03-SHOULD-NOT-WRITE.json inside a throwaway repository and the guard exits 1 with PO03_PATH_SCOPE_VIOLATION: state/PO03-SHOULD-NOT-WRITE.json; deleting that same out-of-allowlist file also exits 1; an unresolvable base exits 2 with PO03_PATH_SCOPE_ERROR rather than passing. Ran python3 -I -m unittest discover over the unit subtree: 18 tests, OK, exit 0, captured in evidence/test-run.txt. Two of those tests substitute deliberately broken guards to prove the fixture is not vacuous: a guard that always prints PO03_PATH_SCOPE_PASS and exits 0 produces at least ten deviations while still passing both controls, and a guard that always exits 1 makes the controls deviate. Three further tests assert the fixture never touches the repository under test: git status --porcelain and HEAD are unchanged across a full run, the scratch repository is a distinct repository, and the scratch directory is empty afterwards.
falsifiable_hypothesis: The path-scope guard has real rejection power, demonstrated by a deliberate out-of-allowlist mutation fixture.
limitations: The fixture asserts what the guard reports about a change set it is handed; it cannot assert that CI hands the guard the correct change set, which depends on the workflow's --base and --head arguments and is a separate surface addressed by unit 031.
A full run costs about 46 to 94 seconds of wall time depending on load, almost entirely git and interpreter process spawns, so it suits a pull-request gate rather than a tight inner loop.

Rejection power is proven only for the path spellings enumerated in the fixture. Traversal, symlink, unicode, case-variant spellings and change sets whose full mutation is not visible to git diff --name-only are unit 028's subject, and unit 028 found real gaps there, so this PASS must not be read as the guard being complete.
